description: Photo markers that would overlap on screen grouped (apps/android/docs/SPEC.md FR-2.10): in the order given, each point ({ id, x, y }, screen pixels) joins the first group whose first point is within radius, or starts its own. Expected: the groups, { ids, x, y } at their first point.

cases.name: points apart stay apart; points within the radius group
a group's marker sits on its first point, in the order given
grouping is anchored, not chained: a run of close points splits at the radius
the edge of the radius counts
a small radius keeps closer markers apart
